questions.an_1: RAWA is a personal growth app that helps you reflect, set meaningful goals and build sustainable practices across nine areas of life.
questions.q_2: How is my personal plan created?
questions.an_2: Your plan is shaped by your assessment, priorities and preferred pace. You can refine it as your needs change.
questions.q_3: Can I change my goals and practices?
questions.an_3: Yes. RAWA is designed to be flexible, so your goals, routines and recommendations can evolve with you.
questions.q_4: Will RAWA be available in Arabic and English?
questions.an_4: Yes. RAWA is designed as a bilingual experience with complete Arabic and English support.
